units.source_text: 后来，小姐偶尔有事来我房间，顺便坐下来聊个没完。

en.t: Later, the young lady would sometimes come to my room on some errand, sit down while she was there, and talk on without end.

units.source_text: 每当这时，我的心里就会有异样的不安。

en.t: Whenever this happened, a strange uneasiness would arise in my heart.

units.source_text: 而且，这并不仅仅因为和年轻女子面对面而感觉不安。

en.t: And it was not simply because I felt uneasy sitting face to face with a young woman.

units.source_text: 不知什么缘故，我总觉得心神不宁，某种自己背叛自己般的不正常的心态折磨着我。

en.t: For some reason, I always felt restless, and an unnatural state of mind, as if I were betraying myself, tormented me.

units.source_text: 可是，小姐却十分淡定，全无羞涩之态，以至于令人怀疑她是不是那个弹琴时连曲子都唱不成调的女子。

en.t: Yet the young lady herself was perfectly calm and showed no shyness at all, so much so that one could doubt whether she was the same woman who, when practicing the koto, could not even sing the tune properly.

units.source_text: 有时候由于小姐待得太久，夫人便在客厅那边喊她，可她也只是应一声，并不马上离开。

en.t: Sometimes, because she stayed too long, her mother would call her from the sitting room, but she would merely answer and would not leave at once.

units.source_text: 但小姐绝非幼稚女童，这一点我看得很明白，小姐的举止也明显表现出想让我明白这一点。

en.t: But the young lady was by no means a childish girl; I could see that very clearly, and her behavior plainly showed that she wanted me to understand it too.
